name: ═══════════════ VICTRON ENERGY TELEGRAM INTERFACE ═══════════════
info:
## Victron Energy Telegram Interface

**Flow Number:** 812
**Domain:** Energy Management (800-899)

### Commands
- `/energy_status` — battery, grid, PV, load, headroom, inverter
- `/energy_start` — start discretionary loads (when headroom OK)
- `/energy_stop` — stop discretionary loads
- `/energy_help` — help and inline buttons

### Data
- Reads `global.victron_energy_state` (flow 811)
- Publishes `energy/victron/command/discretionary/start|stop`
- Retained `energy/victron/automation/discretionary_load/state`

### Dependencies
- `50-telegram-interface.json` (authorization + link)
- `811-victron-energy-status.json` (global state)
- `telegram_bot_config` / `LuncaCetatuiiAutomationBot_bot`
